title: Split file part
text: One part of a file split into several. Download all parts and point the tool at the first one.

title: K-quant mix size
text: _S, _M and _L are small, medium and large mixes of the same base type. A bigger mix gives more bits to the tensors that hurt quality most when rounded. Q3_K, Q4_K and Q5_K alone are aliases for the _M versions.

title: Effective parameters
text: Google Gemma effective parameters. The file is bigger than the number suggests because of the large per-layer embedding tables.

title: Mixture of experts size
text: Total parameters, then the parameters active per token. You need memory for the total. Speed follows the active number.

title: Parameter count
text: Billions of parameters. Memory for weights is about this number times bits per weight divided by 8, in GB.

title: XL mix size
text: _XL is a size label for a larger mix of a K-quant, not a llama.cpp type. With the UD- prefix it is Unsloth's own label, which Unsloth does not define in its docs. On bartowski files (Q3_K_XL, Q6_K_L style) it means the standard quant with the embedding and output weights at Q8_0.
